about_the_game:
Crystant is a post-apocalyptic survival game where you play as a test subject trapped in an underground laboratory. Step by step, you explore the corridors ahead, facing mysterious creatures and unknown events.

Introduction

You wake up from a sudden quake, reminded of your current predicament—locked away in a windowless laboratory.
Suddenly, the door opens. Blinding white light floods in, revealing a long corridor leading into the unknown. Flickering lights shimmer in the distance.

After a long hesitation, you finally muster the courage to venture forward…

Key Features

  • Encounters filled with unknown dangers

  • Equip specialized weapons to enhance your class abilities

    Different classes can equip their corresponding signature weapons, allowing each character to unleash their full potential.

  • Scavenge for resources and struggle to survive

    Resources are scarce and filled with danger. Every expedition may lead to a breakthrough—or a disaster. You must make critical decisions with limited supplies to ensure you survive long enough to reach the next floor.

  • Unique tactical, turn-based combat system

    Combat is built on a predictable yet deeply strategic grid-based system. Players must carefully consider positioning, skill timing, and enemy behavior patterns.

  • Enemies with randomized attribute enhancements

    During every run, enemies may gain random enhancement traits, turning familiar foes into unpredictable threats and forcing you to adapt your strategy.

  • Stronger Enemies

    In the deeper areas, you’ll encounter more powerful foes — enemies with higher defenses, deadlier attack patterns, and unique abilities. Stay cautious and use your resources and strategies wisely if you hope to survive.

  • Forge Your Own Combat Build

    Master the four core attributes, enhance your team’s capabilities, and build the strategy that suits you best.

  • Collect special chips to accelerate progression

    Learning Chips can be used to enhance core attributes and accelerate your character’s growth.

  • Access recovery, training, and insight functions in specific areas

    In designated rest areas, you can use Recovery to regain HP through short rest, Training to consume Chips for ability upgrades and faster EXP gain, and Insight to operate surveillance systems that remotely reveal sections of the map. These features provide breathing room between encounters and allow you to plan ahead for the increasingly dangerous zones ahead.

  • Achievement system to unlock classes and boost abilities

    By earning Achievement Points, you can unlock additional character classes and passive upgrades, encouraging players to experiment with different playstyles and explore deeper build possibilities.

  • Carry over EXP and CV into a new run

    After each cycle, accumulated experience and special currency are carried over, giving you an advantage in the next run and reinforcing the long-term progression of a roguelite structure.

  • Collect story fragments to uncover the truth behind the disaster (Demo version not supported)

    Scattered research logs and fragmented documents can be found throughout the facility. Piecing them together gradually reveals the laboratory’s secrets and the true cause of the disaster.

content_descriptors.notes: This game may contain content not suitable for all ages or for viewing in the workplace: general adult themes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or Later
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz or higher
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 512 MB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 400 MB available space

short_description: Crystant is a top-down roguelike set in a post-apocalyptic underground facility. Explore tangled tunnels, face strange mutants, and survive with limited resources. Hidden events, deadly traps, and clues await. Will you uncover the truth or fall into the darkness?
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Russian, Ukrainian, Polish
